title: Robot-gearbox lubricant temperature
review_mode: read-only review of retained scientific/equation/evidence records; no fitting, acquisition or new literature search
review_scope: Original findings, first continuation when present, latest continuation and supplemental material-response tasks when present. Independent computational review is a separate artifact.
grouping_and_information_scope: Complete runs from one gearbox; external causal forcing plus first lubricanttemperature initialization; startup excluded from score.
portfolio_disposition: Scoped numerical references, tested hypotheses and preserved falsifications; no independently established new fundamental law or demonstrated deployment impact is admitted.
aggregate_score_reason: Scientific dimensions are distinct; task difficulty and validation scope are disclosed without converting them into invented precision or a composite discovery score.

finding_reviews.statement: A causal housing/speed observer is a useful calibrated reference within one gearbox, with long-duration failures.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.

equation_if_supported.interpretation: Executable numerical representation only; mechanism/novelty admission is assessed separately. Displayed coefficients can be rounded; exact executable states are authoritative.

finding_reviews.strongest_adverse_evidence: Worst original run 2.728 C; no new gearbox/sensorless claim. Source already describes an observer.

mechanism.rationale: Stable memory modes are interpretable observer states, not independently identified heat capacities or heat-transfer paths. Five constant-speed runs underexcite competing mechanisms.

novelty.rationale: The source two-state observer has unmatched reported 1.3 KMAE; absent exact code/coefficients prohibit superiority claims. No new thermodynamic law. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Complete runs from one gearbox; external causal forcing plus first lubricanttemperature initialization; startup excluded from score.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.

scientific_validators: Perturb future forcing and later lubricant targets to confirm prefix invariance.

Test stable recurrences, parametergrid sensitivity and prespecified temperature-alarm delay/miss rates only if independent thresholds exist.
finding_reviews.next_evidence: Fresh variableload/cooldown experiments, jointly excited torque and speed, author observer reproduction and independent gearboxes.
